spec.description:
Foilboard Green is an Australian-manufactured rigid insulation
panel engineered from a fire-retardant expanded polystyrene (EPS) core laminated
on both sides with pure aluminum foil facings. Designed for roofs, external and
internal walls, retrofits, and suspended timber underfloors, it provides
a 3-in-1 thermal insulation, thermal break, and moisture vapor barrier. When
paired with adjacent reflective airspaces, it achieves total system R-values
from R1.6 to R4.0+ across 10mm to 50mm board thicknesses.
features:
3-in-1 insulation, thermal break, and moisture barrier in a single rigid
panel
Pure aluminum reflective facings reflect up to 97% of radiant heat

Achieves total system
R-values up to R4.0+ when paired with sealed airspaces

Fiber-free,
non-allergenic, non-carcinogenic, and non-itchy formulation

Impermeable to
water and will not sag, rot, or deteriorate over time

Anti-glare green
coating on one face for safe installation in bright sunlight

Extremely
lightweight, rigid, and fast to cut and fix on site

Group 1 fire hazard
classification compliant with AS 5637.1 / AS ISO 9705

Backed by a 25-year
manufacturer performance warranty

install:
Ensure
structural framing or substrate is level, clean, and dry

Measure and cut
panels using a sharp utility knife or hand saw

Maintain a minimum 20mm sealed
airspace adjacent to reflective foil faces to generate full thermal R-value

For walls, fix horizontally or vertically across framing with mechanical
fasteners and blank plates

For underfloors, install between joists supported
on Foilboard Floor Saddles or Retrofit Clips

Butt sheet joints tightly and
tape with Foilboard 72mm reinforced aluminum tape

Seal all edges around
windows, doors, and service penetrations to maintain airtightness

Ensure
anti-glare green face faces the installer during roof and sunny external
installations
selection_checklist:
Determine required Total R-value
(R1.6 to R4.0) to meet NCC or NatHERS targets

Select board thickness (10mm
to 50mm) based on available cavity depth

Verify minimum 20mm reflective
airspace can be maintained in the assembly

Order matching installation
accessories (Floor Saddles, Flexifast, 72mm tape)
limitations:
Requires an adjacent sealed airspace of at
least 20mm to deliver rated Total R-value

Avoid contact with organic
solvents, petroleum fuels, and solvent-based adhesives which dissolve EPS

Do
not leave permanently exposed to direct outdoor UV weather without cladding

use_cases:
Underfloor
insulation between joists in suspended timber floor homes to eliminate draughts

Continuous external wall thermal break and insulation behind
brick veneer or lightweight cladding

Lining internal walls and ceilings of
domestic garages, workshops, and metal sheds

Insulating cathedral and raked
ceilings where cavity depth is restricted
not_for:

immersion or subterranean hydrostatic tanking

Direct foot traffic without
floorboards or overlay
retrieval.rag_summary:
Foilboard Green is a rigid Australian-made insulation board composed of a
fire-retardant EPS core laminated with pure aluminum foil facings on both sides.
Available in thicknesses from 10mm to 50mm (Total R-values from R1.6 to R4.0+
when paired with airspaces), it acts as a combined thermal insulator, thermal
break, and vapor barrier across walls, roofs, sheds, and suspended timber
floors. Fiber-free, moisture-impermeable, non-allergenic, and tested to Group 1
fire standards, it delivers lifetime thermal efficiency backed by a 25-year
performance warranty.
